trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Final paragraph opens 'The six millennium problems are not independent questions but six instances of a single substrate-stability requirement' — assert-by-denying, and it contradicts the block's own correction three paragraphs earlier ('Read the table as five instances of a squeeze plus one rate comparison sharing a notation, not as six instances of one theorem'). The other denials (the NS-row correction) are substantive and stay.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: STRUCTURAL — do not fix cosmetically. The correction paragraphs (NS row is a rate comparison, not a squeeze instance) were inserted without reconciling the opener ('Six ... reduce to a single surreal inequality') or the last two paragraphs. Proposed: rewrite the closing paragraph as 'Five of the six ... are instances of one substrate-stability requirement; the Navier--Stokes row is a rate comparison in the same notation', and qualify the opener the same way.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: 'Both patterns are individually coherent — ... — but they are not the same argument' is a concession followed by the argument's actual point, not a setup whose trailing clause carries undisclosed weight.

trap-em-dash.evidence: 3 em-dashes over 670 words; one appositive and one matched parenthetical pair. No structural substitution.

trap-triples.evidence: Enumerations are six-fold (the six problems) and match the table rows; no reflex three-item list.

trap-closing-aphorism.evidence: Ends on 'The two are equivalent by the Big-O bridge', a technical claim about the two registers.

trap-meta-commentary.evidence: no meta-commentary on the block's own rhetoric
'Read the table as five instances ... not as six instances of one theorem' is load-bearing disambiguation stated directly (false-positive class), not narrated emphasis; 'we recall' is standard.

trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: The penultimate paragraph restates the opening thesis at block end ('Six ... reduce to a single surreal inequality' -> 'The six millennium problems are ... six instances of a single substrate-stability requirement') and then adds only labels ('the spectral instance', 'the hydrodynamic instance', ...). No new content, and it re-asserts the reading the block withdrew.
trap-thesis-restatement.notes: STRUCTURAL — same fix as trap-negation-contrast: the restating paragraph should either be deleted or rewritten to agree with the five-plus-one correction. Note 'Navier--Stokes is the hydrodynamic instance' is the specific sentence the correction paragraph withdraws.

trap-superlative.evidence: Claims carry their conditionality per row (rows 4 and 5 conditional on named conjectures); 'rendering the squeeze strictly local-global' is a technical claim about the adelic refinement.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: Sentences are long but clause-structured; reads aloud.
